Too many people live their lives attached to physical items, to their ego and satisfying their wants and desires. You have lived and died many times before, you are everyone and everything in this universe, and they are you. The things that people fill their days with matter not. Money matters not. This does not mean that our lives are meaningless, and pointless to live. What does matter is how you treat people, the difference you make in the world and others lives, because how are we measured if not in the ways we affect others lives. Live life not for wealth or fame, do not worry about boredom or fulfilling the wants of your ego. Live, love, and let life happen of its own accord. And most importantly, enjoy where you are at in life, no matter where it may take you.
Once you realize that you have died and lived many many times before, you know what really matters in life.

Having recently discovered voat.co, I've thought about having a place to discuss the state of the site and the community. Similar to other sites with places for meta discussion, I have created a subverse for all things on voat itself.

https://voat.co/v/MetaVoat

While there might be overlapping functionalities between my proposed subverse and /v/ideasforvoat (that being both aiming to improve the site), the difference between MetaVoat and ideasforvoat is that MetaVoat is more of a subverse for questions, discussions and (uncensored) criticism, whereas ideasforvoat is a subverse for ideas and suggestions that already have a basis.

Feedback is always welcome! That is, until /v/MetaMetaVoat becomes a thing.
